dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Panay Island, Catanduanes Province, Bicol Region, The Philippines as of 18 November 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20241117PHL, GDACS ID: 1001124** This map provides an analysis of structures potentially impacted by Typhoon Man-Yi, utilizing imagery from the Pleiades satellite acquired on 18 and 20 November 2024. Within the defined analysis area, UNOSAT has identified 45 structures as damaged and 37 as potentially damaged. Out of a total of 132 buildings identified within the analysis extent, this represents approximately 50% of buildings as damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
